title: Project Anubhav privacy notice
status: Draft — developer contact details, hosting provider, retention and child-account verification must be confirmed before publication.

sections.heading: Information used by the app
sections.body: Account email, password hash, teacher or parent name, optional school name, games, class names and student counts, and activity history are stored to provide your account and classroom features. Do not enter student names, contact details, health information or other sensitive details in free-text fields. Passwords are hashed; the app does not store readable passwords.

sections.heading: Purpose and sharing
sections.body: Information is used for sign-in, saving your classroom content, and maintaining account security. The current app has no advertising, analytics, tracking SDKs, location collection, camera or microphone access. The hosting provider processes service data when deployed; its identity and hosting region must be confirmed before release. The current font library may request font files from Google; this must be removed or accounted for before a child-directed release.

sections.heading: Sessions and security
sections.body: The browser uses an HttpOnly session cookie. Session tokens expire after seven days and are revoked on logout or account deletion. Password verification uses salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256. Authentication attempts temporarily record email, client IP and time for rate limiting. Attempt records older than 15 minutes are removed on the next authentication request. Production hosting must use HTTPS.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Account and classroom records remain until you delete them or delete the account. Deleting a game or class keeps its title in activity history. Deleting the account removes its profile, games, classes, activity history, sessions and matching authentication-attempt records from the active database. The app-managed pre-account migration backup is removed when its owning account is deleted. External hosting backups and operational logs are not managed by this app; their retention must be documented before deployment.

sections.heading: Children and managed accounts
sections.body: The planned audience includes teachers and children in India. This build does not yet provide verified parent/guardian consent or managed child accounts. Do not register child accounts or enter children's personal information until the child-account verification flow and audience disclosures are completed. A teacher confirmation or checkbox alone is not treated as verified parental consent.

sections.heading: Your controls
sections.body: You can edit your profile and classroom records, log out, and delete your account from Me. The public /delete-account page allows account deletion without the app installed. Deletion requires your current password and confirmation. Contact the developer for questions or if you cannot access your account; the developer must supply a working support address before release.
